summary_1line: Krishna plans a peace mission while condemning Duryodhana’s past crimes; Bhima urges mild diplomacy despite believing Duryodhana’s nature makes war inevitable.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dussasana drags the weeping Draupadi by her hair into the royal assembly as silent elders like Bhishma and Drona watch in anguish.
Krishna speaks solemnly of dreadful omens as birds shriek at dusk and fire burns in strange colors before the coming war.
Bhima, mighty yet restrained, urges Krishna to address Duryodhana with gentle words to avoid the destruction of the Bharata race.
